text:
jessica.support: Hi team — escalating ticket SR-123456 from Acme Robotics. Customer says the Console shows a $300 promotional credit on their org (acme-robotics) but our billing API and metering show 0 credits and they're getting charged. Screenshot uploaded: https://redwood.screens/acme/shot.png :exclamation:

claire.billing: can you paste the service key + org_id they're using? also which endpoints return 0 credits (metering vs billing)?

jessica.support: service key shown in UI: sk-acme-prod-01, org_id: org_7z. I called GET /v1/billing/credits with that key and got `[]` (no credits). Customer sent an invoice showing actual charges. Ticket notes they were recently merged from a legacy org to the new org last night.

ian-eng: thanks. sounds like a sync/migration edge. Console reads the aggregated view from billing-store, API metering reads from the ledger service. when orgs merged we have a known race where credits can get attached to the old org_id and not propagated to the ledger.

ian-eng: quick repro steps I ran locally:
```
# check credits via billing service
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-prod-01" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/credits
# expected [] in customer's case
# check ledger directly (admin)
rbw admin ledger show --org org_7z
```

jessica.support: ran the first curl with customer key — returned empty. can you confirm the admin ledger check and whether credits are on old_org_id?

ian-eng: running lookup now. output snippet shows credits present under `org_7z_old` (the legacy id), not `org_7z`. this matches the merge race.

cache-bot: NOTICE: cache invalidation request queued for org_7z (ttl 300s).

luis-billing-infra: I can fix this. root cause: migration script credit-mapper v1 did not reassign ledger entries when legacy org was tombstoned. I will run a targeted reassignment query to move credits from org_7z_old -> org_7z and then force the propagator to emit a credit-update event. plan: run `rbw admin credits reassign --from org_7z_old --to org_7z --amount 300 --reason "merge-reassign SR-123456"` then `rbw svc events publish credit-update --org org_7z`.

claire.billing: while infra runs that, we should prevent further bill runs for the customer. placing a billing hold on invoices for org_7z. claire.billing: put hold -> done.

jessica.support: I told the customer we're pausing billing and we'll provide a temporary ledger adjustment while we fix the source. they asked for ETA.

luis-billing-infra: executing reassignment now. will post logs.

luis-billing-infra: logs: `reassign: 1 rows updated, 300.00 moved, tx_id tx_9a8b` — publishing event...

cache-bot: NOTICE: credit-update event received for org_7z, invalidating caches.

ian-eng: after event, I polled the billing endpoint and now GET /v1/billing/credits returns `[ { "amount": 300, "source": "promo-2025-02" } ]` using the customer key. also metering shows credits applied to the pending invoice.

jessica.support: confirmed with customer — Console still showed $300 earlier but API had been 0; now both show $300. customer very relieved.

claire.billing: created internal ticket BILL-7890 to track root-cause fix for migration script. assign to luis-billing-infra, P2.

jessica.support: action items: 1) luis to add a safety check in credit-mapper to ensure ledger reassign emits event; 2) infra to add alert when console/api divergence > $50; 3) support to notify customer when hold lifted.

luis-billing-infra: will follow up with PR and a backfill job that scans recent merges. ETA 48h.

jessica.support: thanks all — marking SR-123456 as "remediated pending confirmation" and will follow up with customer later today. :white_check_mark:

claire.billing: leaving note: temporary hold and adjustment applied so customer won't be charged while we finish.

jessica.support: final check at 2270001531: customer confirmed invoices updated, closing loop.
